ins.median_b: The median is the reading in the middle when that day’s readings are put in order from low to high: half are below it and half above. For example, 110, 120, 130, 140 and 400 have a median of 130 and an average of 180. One spike pulls the average up, so the median shows most of the time better.

web.a1: No. Everything works with readings you enter by voice, text or form. Device connections are planned and will be optional.
web.a2: No. Steady records insulin you report taking. It doesn’t calculate, suggest or adjust doses.
web.a3: The app is available in English, Hebrew, Arabic and Russian. Conversation language can be set separately; available voices depend on our speech provider.
web.a4: Not yet. Steady is designed for adults. A family version with guardian permissions is being designed.
web.billing_note: On mobile, billing is handled by the App Store or Google Play. On the web, by our payment provider.
web.can1: Log glucose, meals, insulin you took and activity, by voice or text
web.can2: Estimate carbs from a meal photo, as an estimate you can correct
web.can3: Remember your routine and preferences, which you can review
web.can4: Follow up on what you agreed, at times you choose
web.can5: Show observations together with the records behind them
web.can_h: Clear about what it is, and what it isn’t
web.cant1: Recommend, calculate or adjust insulin doses
web.cant3: Replace your device alarms or monitor you continuously
web.cant4: Act as a nurse, doctor or emergency service
web.disclaimer: Steady is an AI companion for people living with type 1 diabetes. It is not a medical device, does not recommend insulin doses, and does not replace device alarms, emergency services or your care team.
web.eye: For adults living with type 1 diabetes
web.help_b: Use Help in the app. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
web.how_h: Talk, log, and look back, without the busywork
web.how_note: The first few days are about learning your routine. Understanding how your body responds takes much longer, and Steady says so.
web.ph_alt: The Steady app home screen with the companion orb
web.ph_quote: “We noticed a similar rise around lunch on several recorded days. Have you eaten yet?”
web.plan_lead: No tiers, no credits, and never a sales message inside a health conversation.
web.planned_b: Device connections (for example Guardian 4 sensor data) and sharing with your care team are being designed. They are not available today, and Steady works fully with readings you enter yourself.
web.prices_open: Prices and the trial length aren’t final yet. They will appear here once membership is set up.
web.pv1_b: Using your data to run the service and using it to improve models are separate consents. The second is off unless you turn it on.
web.pv2_b: Everything the companion remembers is listed with its source. Edit or remove any of it, or all of it.
web.pv3_b: Download a PDF or CSV export, or delete your account and data from the app or the web.
web.q1: Do I need a sensor or pump?
web.q2: Will it tell me how much insulin to take?
web.s1_b: Say “124 after lunch”, type it, or photograph your plate. You check every number and unit before anything is saved.
web.s2_b: Short check-ins at times you choose, with quiet hours. If you already logged it, the question is withdrawn.
web.s3_b: Observations always show the records behind them, and say plainly when they’re only a first impression.
web.stores_soon: Steady isn’t in the App Store or Google Play yet.
web.sub: Steady is a calm AI companion you can talk to. It logs what you tell it, follows up when you ask, and helps you notice patterns without judgment.
web.trial: Free trial, then one simple membership. Works without a connected device.
